instruments.name: Glide Lead
instruments.description: A single-note filtered sawtooth that slides between notes, for expressive solos and bends.

instruments.name: Upright Bass
instruments.description: A woody, thumpy acoustic double bass with a soft finger thump on each note, for jazz walks and plucked orchestral lows.

instruments.name: Triangle Bass
instruments.description: The soft, round triangle bass of the NES, with a short release so lines stay tight.

instruments.name: Lute Harpsichord
instruments.description: The harpsichord with its lute stop on: short, dry, and muted, for gentle accompaniment.

instruments.name: Solo Violin
instruments.description: A single expressive bowed sawtooth with a vibrato that arrives late and a whisper of bow noise, for solo melodies.

instruments.name: Pizzicato Strings
instruments.description: Short, dry orchestral string plucks that hold their pitch, for staccato string lines and sneaky cartoon tiptoeing.

instruments.name: Opera Diva
instruments.description: Big, sharp-edged voice with a wide, slow vibrato; send it to the Reverb bus for the opera hall.

instruments.name: Choir Aah
instruments.description: Slow-swelling vowel pad, soft and wide, drifting between ah, oh, and ooh.
